changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO task_quiz (task_id, quiz_id, time_limit_minutes, passing_score) SELECT t.id, q.id, 30, 50.00 FROM (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM task WHERE title LIKE 'mock[_]task[_]%') t JOIN (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM quiz WHERE title LIKE 'Mock Quiz %') q ON t.rn = q.rn;
